updates.label: Daniel Sroka completes revised transcript of second interview with Chief Paul and Mayor Frost

descriptionParagraphs.text: On October 17, 2026, Daniel Sroka finished refining the transcript of his second interview with American Fork Police Chief Cameron Paul and Mayor Bradley Frost.
The rough transcript was generated using an automated transcription app, then corrected and revised with AI assistance. Eric Seamons and Daniel Sroka subsequently made manual revisions.
The final PDF documents the second interview. The separately published August 10 audio recording is from the first interview and is not the source recording for this transcript.

updates.label: Daniel Sroka authorizes publication of private interview audio
updates.description: On October 14, 2026, Daniel Sroka gave permission for this site to publish audio of a private interview between Sroka, Mayor Bradley Frost, and Chief Cameron Paul.

$override.description: Rob Shelton reports on the federal lawsuit filed October 14 by Sheldon Norcross, Tyler Shaw, Sierra Lauts, and Steven Allen against American Fork City and 13 officers. The complaint alleges constitutional violations; these allegations have not been adjudicated. Ben Schneider is not a plaintiff.
